term: pasear(sele) el alma por el cuerpo

1.consolidated_definition: Se dice de la persona excesivamente tranquila, que no reacciona ante nada. “No creo que esté María muy preocupada con el viaje; ya sabes que a ella se le pasea el alma por el cuerpo.”
1.en_consolidated_definition:
This phrase is used to describe a person who is excessively calm and unreactive to anything.

It refers to someone who remains unperturbed by events or situations, often to an extent that may be perceived as unusual or excessive.

The expression "se le pasea el alma por el cuerpo" translates to "their soul is wandering freely in their body", implying a state of complete emotional detachment.
